readMe.a: Case Field Health & Tech Debt Analysis — SBU

readMe.b: Identify which Case fields are genuinely in use and which are tech debt, using measured record-level population rather than estimates.
Live Salesforce metadata (describe, FieldDefinition, Tooling CustomField) read directly from SBU production (posnation.my.salesforce.com) on 2026-11-10.

Created Date, Created By, Last Modified, Help Text and Description come from a fresh live Tooling CustomField read on 2026-11-10 for fields that have them. Flow/layout/formula/other reference counts (flows, formulaRefs, layouts, otherRefs, totalRefs, refTypes) are carried over from the 2026-10-25 live read where the field still exists — these structural references change rarely, and re-querying MetadataComponentDependency for all ~480 custom fields hit unreliable large-result handling during this run, so they were not re-measured for this pull. 27 fields newly created since 2026-10-25 default to 0 references (not yet measured).

Live SOQL aggregates against SBU production (org 00D40000000N194EAC, POS Nation) on 2026-11-10. No record export. Population, recency and trend numbers are exact counts over every Case as of today, not a sample.
514 of 529 live Case fields assessed (12 Long Text Area fields not assessable; 1 compound address parent and 2 non-aggregatable system fields excluded).

Checkbox/Formula(Checkbox) fields measure population as the TRUE count, not non-null count (checkboxes default false and are never null). Multi-select picklists measure non-null (any value selected) via a != null filter since SOQL COUNT() does not support multi-select picklist fields directly.

For fields created before the 24-month trend window (2024-11), "since creation" population is approximated as all-time population, and the eligible denominator as the full Case history, since per-field monthly population before that window was not collected in this live pull. For fields created within the trend window, since-creation figures are computed exactly from the monthly series.

Measured exactly (capped at 5, the scoring model's full-credit threshold) for all picklist-type fields via GROUP BY sampling. Non-picklist high-cardinality field types (dates, numbers, free text, lookups) default to 5 (full credit) without a per-field query, since they are reliably high-cardinality.
